  ## How AI-Enabled Planning Will Improve Your Supply Chain Performance
  
  Extreme volatility, inventory shortages and data overload are all challenges businesses are facing
  when it comes to supply chain planning. AI-enabled planning capabilities can address these
  challenges by improving decision-making, agility, and collaboration across supply chain functions.
  [][96]
  
  ## 2026 Supply Chain Compass: How Supply Chain leaders are navigating complexity
  
  The Supply Chain Compass 2026 report surveys nearly 700 supply chain leaders, exploring how they
  are navigating a rapidly evolving landscape shaped by AI, disruption, and rising expectations.
  While nearly half express strong optimism about the future, the report reveals that this
  confidence is driven by greater visibility, stronger technology adoption, and more integrated,
  data-driven supply chain strategies.
  [][97]
  
  ## Beyond Silos: Evolving to an Enterprise Supply Chain
  
  Incisiv explores the significant transformation underway in modern supply chains, detailing the
  shift away from fragmented processes and point solutions to more agile platforms and collaborative
  workflows. This evolution addresses systemic issues such as inflexibility and disconnected
  communication, enhancing supply chain responsiveness, sustainability, and profitability.

  ## How AI-Enabled Planning Will Improve Your Supply Chain Performance
  
  Extreme volatility, inventory shortages and data overload are all challenges businesses are facing
  when it comes to supply chain planning. AI-enabled planning capabilities can address these
  challenges by improving decision-making, agility, and collaboration across supply chain functions.
  [][96]
  
  ## 2026 Supply Chain Compass: How Supply Chain leaders are navigating complexity
  
  The Supply Chain Compass 2026 report surveys nearly 700 supply chain leaders, exploring how they
  are navigating a rapidly evolving landscape shaped by AI, disruption, and rising expectations.
  While nearly half express strong optimism about the future, the report reveals that this
  confidence is driven by greater visibility, stronger technology adoption, and more integrated,
  data-driven supply chain strategies.
  [][97]
  
  ## Beyond Silos: Evolving to an Enterprise Supply Chain
  
  Incisiv explores the significant transformation underway in modern supply chains, detailing the
  shift away from fragmented processes and point solutions to more agile platforms and collaborative
  workflows. This evolution addresses systemic issues such as inflexibility and disconnected
  communication, enhancing supply chain responsiveness, sustainability, and profitability.

## What makes your Infor CloudSuite agentic?

Infor Velocity Suite is the AI accelerator that pairs with every Infor CloudSuite. Add Infor
Velocity Suite, and your business becomes an agentic enterprise – where AI agents execute work
end-to-end, experiences adapt to every role, and every action is governed by default.

team members with precise, auditable outcomes.

  ## How AI-Enabled Planning Will Improve Your Supply Chain Performance
  
  Extreme volatility, inventory shortages and data overload are all challenges businesses are facing
  when it comes to supply chain planning. AI-enabled planning capabilities can address these
  challenges by improving decision-making, agility, and collaboration across supply chain functions.
  [][96]
  
  ## 2026 Supply Chain Compass: How Supply Chain leaders are navigating complexity
  
  The Supply Chain Compass 2026 report surveys nearly 700 supply chain leaders, exploring how they
  are navigating a rapidly evolving landscape shaped by AI, disruption, and rising expectations.
  While nearly half express strong optimism about the future, the report reveals that this
  confidence is driven by greater visibility, stronger technology adoption, and more integrated,
  data-driven supply chain strategies.
  [][97]
  
  ## Beyond Silos: Evolving to an Enterprise Supply Chain
  
  Incisiv explores the significant transformation underway in modern supply chains, detailing the
  shift away from fragmented processes and point solutions to more agile platforms and collaborative
  workflows. This evolution addresses systemic issues such as inflexibility and disconnected
  communication, enhancing supply chain responsiveness, sustainability, and profitability.

  ## How AI-Enabled Planning Will Improve Your Supply Chain Performance
  
  Extreme volatility, inventory shortages and data overload are all challenges businesses are facing
  when it comes to supply chain planning. AI-enabled planning capabilities can address these
  challenges by improving decision-making, agility, and collaboration across supply chain functions.
  [][96]
  
  ## 2026 Supply Chain Compass: How Supply Chain leaders are navigating complexity
  
  The Supply Chain Compass 2026 report surveys nearly 700 supply chain leaders, exploring how they
  are navigating a rapidly evolving landscape shaped by AI, disruption, and rising expectations.
  While nearly half express strong optimism about the future, the report reveals that this
  confidence is driven by greater visibility, stronger technology adoption, and more integrated,
  data-driven supply chain strategies.
  [][97]
  
  ## Beyond Silos: Evolving to an Enterprise Supply Chain
  
  Incisiv explores the significant transformation underway in modern supply chains, detailing the
  shift away from fragmented processes and point solutions to more agile platforms and collaborative
  workflows. This evolution addresses systemic issues such as inflexibility and disconnected
  communication, enhancing supply chain responsiveness, sustainability, and profitability.

# Driving **efficiency and visibility** across your supply chain

Our innovative solutions optimize supply chain operations—from sourcing and supplier management to
logistics execution and real-time asset tracking. We empower businesses to achieve greater agility
and resilience, delivering value through improved visibility, cost efficiency, and optimized
performance.


## **Unlocking smarter, faster, and more efficient global supply chains**

 

##### [**Ocean carriers**][35]

Optimize landside operations with centralized contract management, transport execution, real-time
visibility, and enhanced asset utilization.

##### [**Rail carriers**][36]

Enhance operations with advanced asset management, real-time visibility, and IoT-driven insights.
Optimize equipment utilization, reduce empty moves, and streamline container flow within terminals
for operational excellence.

##### [**Manufacturers**][37]

Streamline sourcing, enhance supplier collaboration, and optimize logistics execution with tools
that deliver real-time visibility and control. Reduce costs, mitigate risks, and transform your
supply chain operations.

#####  [**Terminal operators**][38]

Optimize terminal operations with appointment scheduling and terminal fee payment solutions.
Streamline container flow, reduce congestion, and integrate seamlessly with your terminal operating
system (TOS).

##### [**Logistics service providers**][39]

Connect drayage, rail, and ocean workflows with real-time visibility and automated execution.
Improve operational efficiency, reduce manual effort, and gain cleaner data across your end-to-end
transportation network.




## **Why choose Blume Global?**


##### ****

Simplify complex supply chains with solutions that seamlessly manage sourcing, supplier networks,
and multimodal logistics from origin to destination—eliminating inefficiencies and ensuring
uninterrupted operations.

##### ****

##### **Streamlined logistics execution**


Optimize freight utilization, reduce costs, and improve planning with real-time visibility, better
carrier rates, and economies of scale—delivering greater value to your customers.

##### ****

Leverage real-time tracking and advanced analytics to make smarter decisions, enhance agility, and
optimize supply chain performance while mitigating disruptions.


##### ****

##### **Global network advantage**

With a presence in 170+ countries, Blume connects suppliers, manufacturers, carriers, and logistics
service providers to drive seamless coordination and operational excellence worldwide.

##### ****

stay ahead in supply chain innovation.

limited, labor efficiency has reached a bottleneck, and the transfer efficiency cannot be improved
by adding labor, it has become a reality for automated logistics transfer to replace intensive
manual operations. Become the inevitable choice for the world's logistics companies. Automated
logistics transfer solutions can provide express logistics companies with accurate billing basis,
real-time sorting information, reasonable vehicle management and long-term historical data. As the

timely data, providing basic information for express sorting, cost settlement, logistics

###### Why Plug-In Freight Ops™?

# The Industry Needs Coordination,Not More Fragmentation

The biggest challenge in logistics is not finding freight. It’s coordinating people, systems,
partners, and
execution after the shipment is booked.

### Shippers & Forwarders

Submit requests, coordinate bookings, access partner networks, and manage freight execution.

### Airlines & GSAs

Expand commercial reach, activate markets, and connect capacity with qualified freight
opportunities.

### Trucking Partners

Participate in airport transfers, first-mile, final-mile, and specialized cargo movements.

### Government & DBEs

Increase participation, compliance visibility, and measurable operational outcomes.

## The Future ofTransportationExecution Infrastructure

Plug-In Freight Ops™ is building the digital coordination layer for fragmented transportation
ecosystems.

Not another logistics platform.
Infrastructure for execution visibility, ecosystem coordination,
workforce activation, and operational accountability.

# Intuitive Inventory Management
# and more with InvenTree

InvenTree is an open-source inventory management system which provides intuitive parts management
and stock control. A wide range of features makes InvenTree the perfect choice for businesses and
hobbyists alike. InvenTree is designed to be extensible, and provides multiple options for
integration with external applications or addition of custom plugins.

[hero]

# InvenTree builds its vast functions on top of a few core workflows

[Learn More [Arrow pointing right]][6]

## Organize Parts

Parts are the fundamental element of any inventory. InvenTree groups parts into structured
categories which allow you to arrange parts to meet your particular needs.

[Learn More [Arrow pointing right]][7]

## Manage Suppliers

InvenTree allows you to easily create, modify or delete suppliers and supplier items linked to any
part in your inventory.

[Learn More [Arrow pointing right]][8]

## Instant Stock Knowledge

Instantly view current stock for a certain part, in a particular location, or required for an
individual build.

[Learn More [Arrow pointing right]][9]

## BOM Management

Intelligent **B**ill **o**f **M**aterial management provides a clear understanding of the sub-parts
required to make a new part.

[Learn More [Arrow pointing right]][10]

# Intuitive Inventory Management
# and more with InvenTree

InvenTree is an open-source inventory management system which provides intuitive parts management
and stock control. A wide range of features makes InvenTree the perfect choice for businesses and
hobbyists alike. InvenTree is designed to be extensible, and provides multiple options for
integration with external applications or addition of custom plugins.

[hero]

# InvenTree builds its vast functions on top of a few core workflows

[Learn More [Arrow pointing right]][6]

## Organize Parts

Parts are the fundamental element of any inventory. InvenTree groups parts into structured
categories which allow you to arrange parts to meet your particular needs.

[Learn More [Arrow pointing right]][7]

## Manage Suppliers

InvenTree allows you to easily create, modify or delete suppliers and supplier items linked to any
part in your inventory.

[Learn More [Arrow pointing right]][8]

## Instant Stock Knowledge

Instantly view current stock for a certain part, in a particular location, or required for an
individual build.

[Learn More [Arrow pointing right]][9]

## BOM Management

Intelligent **B**ill **o**f **M**aterial management provides a clear understanding of the sub-parts
required to make a new part.

[Learn More [Arrow pointing right]][10]

# The OCS Inventory project is entering a new era with version **3.0**. We need your help to test
# and provide feedback on this new release.

 OCS 3.0 is a complete technological redesign: RESTful API-driven architecture, cross-platform
Dart-based agent, unified data models, and a modern Vue.js web UI.
 
⚠️ **This is a Release Candidate. It is intended for testing purposes only and should not be
deployed in production.**
[ Learn more on GitHub ][14]
[ Documentation ][15]

Using version 2.x? Check out the architecture shift guide: 👉 [What changed between v2 and v3][16]

## About OCS inventory

**Open computers and software inventory** is an **asset management solution.**

It is an **open source** software. It allows you to **scan** and **inventory** all your devices in
your IT Department. Once you know everything about your machines, on **hardware** and **software**
sides, you can deploy **packages** to keep your environment **safe**. Many **plugins** are available
and give high flexibility to fit OCS Inventory to your own system. [FactorFX][17] is the main
contributor and daily edit the software. This french society guides companies in integrating and
supporting OCS Inventory.

[ Contact us to learn more about professional features ][18]
[ocs]

## specifics of solution

### Inventory management

Since 2001, **OCS Inventory** has been looking to make hardware and software inventory of computers
more efficient. OCS Inventory queries its **agents** to know the **soft and hard composition** of
each machine, each server. OCS Inventory also queries the network to discover the active elements
that cannot receive an agent. Since version 2.0, OCS Inventory integrates the functionality of
**SNMP scans**.

The main purpose of this integration is to complement the data collected by **ipdiscover.** Using
SNMP scans will allow you to insert a lot of information about your network hardware: printers,
switches, computers (which do not have an OCS agent installed), etc. SNMP scans will be performed by
OCS agents based on IP addresses collected by ipdiscover.

### The remote deployment

**OCS Inventory** includes the **package deployment** feature, in order not to control, but to
ensure uniformity of the software environments present on the network. From the central management
server, you can upload the packets that will be downloaded using HTTP/HTTPS and launched by the**
agent** on the client computer. OCS remote deployment is configurable so that sent packets impact
the network’s quality of service as little as possible. OCS is used as a deployment tool on parks
with **more than 150 000 machines**.

## Features

### Relevant inventory information

### Advanced broadcasting system for deploying software installations or executing scripts and
### commands on computers without overloading the network

### User-friendly Web interface

### Support for many operating systems including : Microsoft Windows, Linux, BSD, Sun Solaris, IBM
### AIX, HP-UX, MacOS X, Android

### Web service accessible through the SOAP interface

### Support plugins through APIs

### Network discovery

### N-tier architecture using common standards, HTTP/HTTPS protocols, and XML data formatting

[ Learn more about features of OCS Inventory… ][19]

## Third-party tools

CMD Build is an open source web environment for the configuration of custom applications for asset
management. CMDBuild Ready2Use, vertical solution of CMDBuild created for the IT Assets & Service
Management, implements workflows, reports, dashboards and sync connectors with external systems for
automatic discovery and monitoring, including OCS Inventory.

iTop is the hub to build a single solution that covers various customers while protecting the
confidentiality essential to every organization. Designed by experienced IT service professionals,
iTop has been created to manage the complexity of shared infrastructures.

ITSM-NG is a fork of the GLPI solution and covers many areas of ITSM. The Open Source tool, is 100%
free, and its main features are : asset management, computer inventory (with OCS Inventory),
helpdesk, and a plugin engine to add additional features. ITSM-NG is a complete tool for managing
projects, contracts, IT assets, and offers dashboards and a full web interface.

## A company behind…

The free is above all a movement of thought, a proof that freedom, respect and sharing can be the
basis of social and economic successes. FactorFX teams are fundamentally acquired to this cause, and
prove every day that it needs to be based on transparency, reliability, and expertise.

with **more than 150 000 machines**.

### Relevant inventory information

### Advanced broadcasting system for deploying software installations or executing scripts and
### commands on computers without overloading the network

### User-friendly Web interface

### Support for many operating systems including : Microsoft Windows, Linux, BSD, Sun Solaris, IBM
### AIX, HP-UX, MacOS X, Android

### Web service accessible through the SOAP interface

### Support plugins through APIs

### Network discovery

### N-tier architecture using common standards, HTTP/HTTPS protocols, and XML data formatting

[ Learn more about features of OCS Inventory… ][19]

## Third-party tools

CMD Build is an open source web environment for the configuration of custom applications for asset
management. CMDBuild Ready2Use, vertical solution of CMDBuild created for the IT Assets & Service
Management, implements workflows, reports, dashboards and sync connectors with external systems for
automatic discovery and monitoring, including OCS Inventory.

iTop is the hub to build a single solution that covers various customers while protecting the
confidentiality essential to every organization. Designed by experienced IT service professionals,
iTop has been created to manage the complexity of shared infrastructures.

ITSM-NG is a fork of the GLPI solution and covers many areas of ITSM. The Open Source tool, is 100%
free, and its main features are : asset management, computer inventory (with OCS Inventory),
helpdesk, and a plugin engine to add additional features. ITSM-NG is a complete tool for managing
projects, contracts, IT assets, and offers dashboards and a full web interface.

### Smart Logistics Solutions

Our flexible automation solutions optimize intralogistics using versatile robot fleets. Guided by
proprietary software, these autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) navigate complex workflows in both
warehouses and factories, handling repetitive tasks with precision. In warehouses, our
Goods-to-Person Picking system maximizes storage space and expedites order fulfillment by
automatically delivering goods to pickers, reducing errors, and increasing throughput. In factories,
AMR solutions facilitate material transport between workstations, optimizing production cycles and
minimizing downtime.

### Our Products

Quicktron offers a variety of autonomous mobile robots (AMRs). Equipped with advanced sensor and AI
technology. These robots navigate the warehouses, fulfillment centers and factories with a
remarkable precision and accuracy.

### Smart Logistics Solutions

Our flexible automation solutions optimize intralogistics using versatile robot fleets. Guided by
proprietary software, these autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) navigate complex workflows in both
warehouses and factories, handling repetitive tasks with precision. In warehouses, our
Goods-to-Person Picking system maximizes storage space and expedites order fulfillment by
automatically delivering goods to pickers, reducing errors, and increasing throughput. In factories,
AMR solutions facilitate material transport between workstations, optimizing production cycles and
minimizing downtime.

### Our Products

Quicktron offers a variety of autonomous mobile robots (AMRs). Equipped with advanced sensor and AI
technology. These robots navigate the warehouses, fulfillment centers and factories with a
remarkable precision and accuracy.

## One Partner, Every Format

Stop outgrowing your manufacturing partner. We manufacture across every major supplement format
under one GMP-compliant roof — so you can expand your product line and streamline quality control
through a single partnership.

### Capsule Manufacturing

Capsules are a great encapsulation form to hold powder or pellet blends. The shell can be made to a
specific design such as being made out of gelatin or a more vegetarian-friendly formulation. Your
powder ingredient formula is encapsulated inside each capsule to create your complete capsule
product.
* Capsules Made With Natural Excipients
* Wet Granulation Process
* Dry Granulation Process
* Vegetarian Capsule Options
* Capsule Filling

[Stock Capsule Products][12][Custom Capsule Manufacturing][13]

### Tablet Manufacturing

Tablets are a powder ingredient formula compressed into a pill form to create a nutraceutical
tablet. Tablets are capable of being compressed into your desired shape and size. One advantage of a
tablet is you can fit more powder into a smaller sized pill compared to a capsule.
* Direct Compression
* Wet Granulation Process
* Dry Granulation Process
* Multiple Tablet Type Options
* Tablet Coating

[Stock Tablet Products][14][Custom Tablet Manufacturing][15]

### Softgel Manufacturing

Softgels are able to have their shape, color, and size customized to however you please. Softgels
offer encapsulation of liquids, instead of powder, which can lead to increased absorbability.
* Fill Material Prep
* Gelatin Filling & Encapsulation
* Tumble Drying
* Drying Tunnel
* Cleaning & Final Inspection

## 基于物流管理的完整产品线

在软件产品方面，唯智秉承为客户创造价值、与客户共同成长的经营服务理念，依托在物流行业丰富的实践经验和
理论研究，在多年积累的基础上，先后推OMS订单管理系统、TMS运输管理系统、 WMS仓库管理系统、
BMS结费管理系统四大主要系统。并后续研发了物流执行系统LES、预约叫号系统YMS、路径优化系统ROS，E-Hub物
流生态平台等产品。

#### [订单管理系统 OMS][33]

企业建立物流自动履约中心和数字化变革的核心软件，作为管理中枢驱动WMS，TMS等物流执行系统进行执行作业

#### [运输管理系统 TMS][34]

各类物流运输场景的执行全流程管控，提供便捷、低门槛的执行操作和及时、可视的过程监控

#### [仓储管理系统 WMS][35]

满足全供应链的协同仓储管理，支持:
原材料仓、半成品仓、线旁库、分销仓、电商仓、混合仓、自动化仓、半自动化仓、人工仓

#### [计费管理系统 BMS][36]

满足物流各环节的计费需求，帮助企业提高计费效率、准确度、规范性

#### [物流执行系统 LES][37]

精准高效的满足生产型企业线边物料的拉动需求，配套若干拉动算法适应各场景需求

#### [仓库执行系统 WES][38]

仓库场景机器设备和人联合作业场景下的库内搬运作业的优化和监控，帮助客户降低自动化仓库运行成本，提高吞
吐量和服务水平

#### [路径优化系统 ROS][39]

通过人工智能算法，自动统筹规划运输路线，帮助企业减少运输成本，提高运输效率

#### [预约管理系统 YMS][40]

满足大型、繁忙的物流中心有序管理场站资源、协调车辆出入仓作业需求，提高场站吞吐能力，打造数字化物流中
心

层楼的重要基础。

## 基于物流管理的完整产品线

在软件产品方面，唯智秉承为客户创造价值、与客户共同成长的经营服务理念，依托在物流行业丰富的实践经验和
理论研究，在多年积累的基础上，先后推OMS订单管理系统、TMS运输管理系统、 WMS仓库管理系统、
BMS结费管理系统四大主要系统。并后续研发了物流执行系统LES、预约叫号系统YMS、路径优化系统ROS，E-Hub物
流生态平台等产品。

#### [订单管理系统 OMS][33]

企业建立物流自动履约中心和数字化变革的核心软件，作为管理中枢驱动WMS，TMS等物流执行系统进行执行作业

#### [运输管理系统 TMS][34]

各类物流运输场景的执行全流程管控，提供便捷、低门槛的执行操作和及时、可视的过程监控

#### [仓储管理系统 WMS][35]

满足全供应链的协同仓储管理，支持:
原材料仓、半成品仓、线旁库、分销仓、电商仓、混合仓、自动化仓、半自动化仓、人工仓

#### [计费管理系统 BMS][36]

满足物流各环节的计费需求，帮助企业提高计费效率、准确度、规范性

#### [物流执行系统 LES][37]

精准高效的满足生产型企业线边物料的拉动需求，配套若干拉动算法适应各场景需求

#### [仓库执行系统 WES][38]

仓库场景机器设备和人联合作业场景下的库内搬运作业的优化和监控，帮助客户降低自动化仓库运行成本，提高吞
吐量和服务水平

#### [路径优化系统 ROS][39]

通过人工智能算法，自动统筹规划运输路线，帮助企业减少运输成本，提高运输效率

#### [预约管理系统 YMS][40]

满足大型、繁忙的物流中心有序管理场站资源、协调车辆出入仓作业需求，提高场站吞吐能力，打造数字化物流中
心

层楼的重要基础。

## 基于物流管理的完整产品线

在软件产品方面，唯智秉承为客户创造价值、与客户共同成长的经营服务理念，依托在物流行业丰富的实践经验和
理论研究，在多年积累的基础上，先后推OMS订单管理系统、TMS运输管理系统、 WMS仓库管理系统、
BMS结费管理系统四大主要系统。并后续研发了物流执行系统LES、预约叫号系统YMS、路径优化系统ROS，E-Hub物
流生态平台等产品。

#### [订单管理系统 OMS][33]

企业建立物流自动履约中心和数字化变革的核心软件，作为管理中枢驱动WMS，TMS等物流执行系统进行执行作业

#### [运输管理系统 TMS][34]

各类物流运输场景的执行全流程管控，提供便捷、低门槛的执行操作和及时、可视的过程监控

#### [仓储管理系统 WMS][35]

满足全供应链的协同仓储管理，支持:
原材料仓、半成品仓、线旁库、分销仓、电商仓、混合仓、自动化仓、半自动化仓、人工仓

#### [计费管理系统 BMS][36]

满足物流各环节的计费需求，帮助企业提高计费效率、准确度、规范性

#### [物流执行系统 LES][37]

精准高效的满足生产型企业线边物料的拉动需求，配套若干拉动算法适应各场景需求

#### [仓库执行系统 WES][38]

仓库场景机器设备和人联合作业场景下的库内搬运作业的优化和监控，帮助客户降低自动化仓库运行成本，提高吞
吐量和服务水平

#### [路径优化系统 ROS][39]

通过人工智能算法，自动统筹规划运输路线，帮助企业减少运输成本，提高运输效率

#### [预约管理系统 YMS][40]

满足大型、繁忙的物流中心有序管理场站资源、协调车辆出入仓作业需求，提高场站吞吐能力，打造数字化物流中
心
